text:
hana.design: Quick design/UX check on the batch vectors preview + relevance table export flow. Usability testing surfaced 3 cross-cutting issues: pagination vs select-all, localized number/decimal display in CSV, and keyboard shortcut discoverability for bulk actions. Trying to align before I update the designs.
praveen.pm: list them out, please.
hana.design: 1) users expect "Select all results" to include items across pages when they click the banner, but our export currently only captures current page. 2) locales: some customers in EU expect comma as decimal separator; when CSV opens in Excel it mis-parses scores. 3) power users want a keyboard shortcut to open export modal (e.g., Shift+E) and an accessible hint.
eli.frontend: for (1) we have server-side paginate tokens; implementing a true "select all" requires a server-side query to materialize ids. That has perf implications for huge datasets. We could: a) limit select-all to max rows (e.g., 10k) and warn, or b) stream export and show progress. Thoughts?
praveen.pm: product preference: support cross-page selects but put a clear limit and explain it in the UI: "Selecting all will export up to 10,000 rows. For larger exports, use the Export API." Add a link to the API docs.
jo.a11y: accessibility notes: when the banner appears after "Select all X results" we need an aria-live polite announcement: "All 1,234 results selected". If we change selection scope (page vs all) provide an explicit control with aria-pressed states. Keyboard: allow shift+arrow to range-select and ensure announce when range selection changes.
hana.design: good. For locale decimals: propose an export option in modal: "Use locale-specific formatting" (on/off) with helper text: "When enabled numbers use your account locale so Excel opens them correctly." Default off for reproducibility.
eli.frontend: implementation note: CSV formatting is currently en-US (dot decimal, comma delimiter). If we switch delimiter to semicolon for comma-decimal locales that helps Excel. We can detect user locale and prefill a suggested delimiter. Also offer TSV as an option.
jo.a11y: ensure the delimiter switch and locale hint are accessible and announced. The export preview should include a small sample (3 rows) with headers and show the exact filename and delimiter used. Announce preview via aria-live when options change.
praveen.pm: copy tweak: change banner copy to "Select all 1,234 results across pages (export up to 10,000)." and add a tiny link "How exports work" that opens docs in a new tab.
hana.design: also request accessible keyboard shortcut hint: show "Shift+E" next to the Export button and add a Tooltip with role="tooltip" and aria-describedby linking to the hint. For discoverability add a short note in keyboard shortcuts modal.
eli.frontend: I'll add shortcut handler and ensure it doesn't conflict. For focus management: opening export modal via keyboard should move focus to first form field (filename) and put aria-hidden on background content. Live region announces "Export dialog opened".
jo.a11y: focus management sounds right. Also when a large export streams, use a role=status live region to update percent progress ("Export progress: 23%") but throttle announcements to avoid chattiness. Use aria-atomic and only announce every 10% or on completion.
praveen.pm: analytics ask: track whether users choose locale-specific formatting, use of select-all, and shortcut usage. This helps decide defaults.
hana.design: final UI changes I'll apply in Figma: 1) banner with clear "Select all" wording + limit, 2) export modal with filename preview, delimiter/locale toggle, sample preview, delimiter summary, and keyboard shortcut hint, 3) tiny inline docs link.
eli.frontend: I'll prototype: select-all will call an endpoint to materialize IDs up to the cap and then stream. Will include progress bar and download link. ETA PR tomorrow.
jo.a11y: I'll run keyboard + screen reader pass when PR lands. Checklist: aria-live for banner & preview changes, focus trap & initial focus, announce export start/complete, throttle progress announcements.
export-ci: automated check: export-select-all-behavior -> WARN (no cap enforcement in branch), csv-locale-detection -> PASS (suggested delimiter provided), a11y-live-region -> WARN (announcements not throttled).
praveen.pm: thanks. Hana, update Figma with the cap messaging and we'll review in morning. If all good ship in next minor.
hana.design: will update now and add copy variants for the banner and modal. thanks team! :sparkles:
